hrngdevice.description: Path to the hardware random number generator device (e.g. /dev/hwrng, /dev/null). Leave empty for auto-detection.

rngdoptions.description: Additional command-line options to pass to the rngd daemon, excluding --hrng/--rng-device which should use HRNGDEVICE instead.

hrngselect.description: Specific RNG selector identifier, used for certain virtualized environments (e.g. virtio_rng.0).
